open_points.subject: start_instance listener-open failure cleanup
open_points.text: when the DiscardResult's removed is false, says that the new store was left with the step of = models.DiscardStep and the kind of = models.DiscardFailureKind its failure names
open_points.other_text: - DiscardResult fields (exact, no others exist): failure: DiscardFailure | None, removed: bool
open_points.question: Must failure be guaranteed non-None whenever removed is false, or must the diagnostic requirement define behavior when failure is None?

open_points.subject: start_instance connection draining after incomplete requests
open_points.text: After writing the answer to an owner interface request that carried a body, and to any request whose body was not read to its framed end, it MUST serve no further request on that connection and close it in stages
open_points.other_text: or, before the request was read whole, end the connection without an answer, and the connection MUST then be closed as a request whose body was not read to its framed end.
open_points.question: Must an incomplete request receive an answer before staged draining, or must staged draining also begin when the connection is ended without an answer?

open_points.subject: start_instance request-header decoding
open_points.text: each header field's value its bytes read as UTF-8 with every byte that is not part of a valid sequence replaced by U+FFFD

  перечисление адресом `= models.SomeStatus` (член — его именем рядом с адресом, §15.3.1),
  константу — именем импортируемого символа
  (`the imported RETRY_LIMIT constant`), настройку — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: Replace the inline encoding and replacement-code-point values with imported provider constants named by the note.
